offering_description.value: Freshpet makes refrigerated meals and treats, primarily for dogs, and also sells refrigerated cat food. It cooks and packages the food in its own facilities and reaches pet owners through retailers with branded in-store refrigerators and through online retail.

primary_products.value: refrigerated dog food rolls; bagged refrigerated dog meals; refrigerated dog treats; refrigerated cat food

customer_segment.value: B2B: Supermarkets, mass-market retailers, warehouse clubs, and pet specialty retailers; B2C: Dog and cat owners

revenue_model.value: product sales: Retailers buy packaged refrigerated pet meals and treats for resale

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Cooks and packages meat, vegetables, and other ingredients into refrigerated pet food for retailers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with sales in Canada and the United Kingdom

specialization.value: related lines: Refrigerated dog meals, dog treats, and cat food

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Branded refrigerators in supermarkets, mass-market stores, warehouse clubs, and pet specialty stores; online: Retailer websites and online pet supply retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA animal food safety and preventive controls, plus state feed labeling and registration rules
